The p.165 line-8 entry distinguishes its from it's, explaining the latter as short for it is. The 166 general comment says non usually takes a hyphen and gives non-empty and non-abelian.

The p167 line10 correction reads so is, with is doubly underlined, followed by a map from C with a raised round index to a primed C with a raised round index. An uncertain sign after the map is cancelled. The property to which so is refers is not supplied on this sheet.

At p.169 line7 the wording in all that follows is proposed as better. At 184 line-15 both reserved for and restricted to are offered. The manuscript order 185 before 184 is retained, with its left-side arrow.

At p186 line-11 the writer questions is more than needed and offers is all that is needed or is more than is needed, ending perhaps. The line-2 entry proposes wording about what those homotopy intervals which aren't weak should be; a repeated what is cancelled and aren't is underlined.
At p.188 l-9 presumably qualifies whatever for, with two cancelled clusters around whatever. The following entry says the end of a line is missing on the copy.

The last entry asks whether the word is manifold and contrasts it with manyfold. The closing parenthesis after manyfold is cancelled; the is inserted before more correct spelling. No live closing parenthesis or final stop is supplied.

brief_feedback: Read only this assigned page and supplied inputs. The whole image and each supplied half were viewed once, followed by eleven distinct enhanced crops recorded in crops/crops.jsonl; all generated crops were displayed. The inventory separates every cited correction entry, the paragraph continuation, nested cancellations, insertion, underline spans and graphic/marginal elements. H is descriptive only, so there are no manufactured H collation rows. No OCR, outside research, other reader output, LaTeX compilation or new agent was used. There is no substantive mathematical verification to report: the sole map occurs in the incomplete phrase so is without its antecedent, and merely parsing its symbols is not entered as a proof or mathematical check. The long rules are given as a page-relative overlay so their physical sides are explicit; their provenance is not assigned.
